text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh: Indeed, by a mighty hand he will let them go; by a mighty hand he will drive them out of his land. ”
text_cn: 上主回答梅瑟说：“现在你就要看见我对法郎所要作的；在强硬的手臂下，他必放走他们；在强硬的手腕下，他必将他们逐出自己的国境。”

text_en: God also spoke to Moses and said to him: “I am the Lord .
text_cn: 天主训示梅瑟说：“我是雅威。

text_en: I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name ‘The Lord ’ I did not make myself known to them.
text_cn: 我曾显现给亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯为‘全能的天主’，但没有以‘雅威’的名字将我启示给他们。

text_en: I also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they resided as aliens.
text_cn: 我也与他们立了约，许下将他们寄居而作客的客纳罕地赐给他们。

text_en: I have also heard the groaning of the Israelites whom the Egyptians are holding as slaves, and I have remembered my covenant.
text_cn: 如今我听见了以色列子民因埃及人的奴役而发的哀号，想起了我的约。

text_en: Say therefore to the Israelites, ‘I am the Lord , and I will free you from the burdens of the Egyptians and deliver you from slavery to them. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
text_cn: 为此你应该对以色列子民说：我是上主，我要使你们摆脱埃及人的虐待，拯救你们脱离他们的奴役，用伸开的手臂，藉严厉的惩罚救赎你们。

text_en: I will take you as my people, and I will be your God. You shall know that I am the Lord your God, who has freed you from the burdens of the Egyptians.
text_cn: 我要以你们作我的百姓，我作你们的天主。你们将承认我是上主，你们的天主，使你们摆脱埃及人的虐待。

text_en: I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; I will give it to you for a possession. I am the Lord . ’”
text_cn: 我领你们要去的地方，就是我举手誓许给亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的地方；我要把那地方赐给你们作为产业。──我是上主。”

text_en: Moses told this to the Israelites; but they would not listen to Moses, because of their broken spirit and their cruel slavery.
text_cn: 梅瑟将这些话告诉了以色列子民，但他们由于苦工丧气，不肯听梅瑟的话。

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses,
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land. ”
text_cn: “你去告诉埃及王法郎说：叫他将以色列子民由他国中放走。”

text_en: But Moses spoke to the Lord , “The Israelites have not listened to me; how then shall Pharaoh listen to me, poor speaker that I am? ”
text_cn: 梅瑟当面回答上主说：“以色列子民既不肯听我，法郎又怎肯听我？况且我又是笨口结舌的人。”

text_en: Thus the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, and gave them orders regarding the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, charging them to free the Israelites from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎，命令他们去见以色列子民和埃及王法郎，好领以色列子民出离埃及国。

text_en: The following are the heads of their ancestral houses: the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
text_cn: 以下是他们家族的族长： 以色列的长子勒乌本的儿子：有哈诺客、帕路、赫兹龙和加尔米：以上是勒乌本的家族。

text_en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
text_cn: 西默盎的儿子：有耶慕耳、雅明、敖哈得、雅津、祚哈尔和客纳罕女子生的儿子沙乌耳：以上是西默盎的家族。

text_en: The following are the names of the sons of Levi according to their genealogies: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and the length of Levi’s life was one hundred thirty-seven years.
text_cn: 以下是肋未的儿子和他们后代的名字：革尔雄、刻哈特和默辣黎。肋未享年一百三十七岁。

text_en: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their families.
text_cn: 革尔雄的儿子：有里贝尼和史米以及他们的家族。

text_en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, and the length of Kohath’s life was one hundred thirty-three years.
text_cn: 刻哈特的儿子：有阿默兰、依兹哈尔、赫贝龙、乌齐耳。刻哈特享年一百三十三岁。

text_en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their genealogies.
text_cn: 默辣黎的儿子有：玛赫里和慕史：以上是肋未各家族和他们的后代。

text_en: Amram married Jochebed his father’s sister and she bore him Aaron and Moses, and the length of Amram’s life was one hundred thirty-seven years.
text_cn: 阿默兰娶了自己的姑母约革贝得为妻， 她给他生了亚郎和梅瑟。阿默兰享年一百三十七岁。

text_en: The sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
text_cn: 依兹哈尔的儿子：有科辣黑、乃斐格和齐革黎。

text_en: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
text_cn: 乌齐耳的儿子：有米沙耳、厄里匝番和息特黎。

text_en: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text_cn: 亚郎娶了阿米纳达布的女儿，纳赫雄的姊妹厄里舍巴为妻，她给亚郎生了纳达布、阿彼胡、厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔。

text_en: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
text_cn: 科辣黑的儿子：有阿息尔、厄耳卡纳和阿彼雅撒夫：以上是科辣黑的各家族。

text_en: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the ancestral houses of the Levites by their families.
text_cn: 亚郎的儿子厄肋阿匝尔娶了普提耳的一个女儿为妻，她给他生了丕乃哈斯：以上是肋未人各支属的族长。

text_en: It was this same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, company by company. ”
text_cn: 天主曾向亚郎和梅瑟说过：“你们应领以色列子民一队一队地出埃及国。”

text_en: It was they who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring the Israelites out of Egypt, the same Moses and Aaron.
text_cn: 这个梅瑟和亚郎曾向埃及王法郎说过：要将以色列子民从埃及领出来。

text_en: On the day when the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
text_cn: 当上主在埃及国对梅瑟说话的那一天，

text_en: he said to him, “I am the Lord ; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I am speaking to you. ”
text_cn: 上主曾对梅瑟说：“我是上主。你应该把我对你所说的一切话告诉埃及王法郎。”

text_en: But Moses said in the Lord ’s presence, “Since I am a poor speaker, why would Pharaoh listen to me? ”
text_cn: 梅瑟当面回答上主说：“看，我是个笨口结舌的人，法郎怎么肯听我？”
